reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: Token Features still states each PGOLD represents 1 troy ounce of 99.99% purity physical gold meeting LBMA standards, with KYC-gated physical redemption. How PGOLD works independently restates 1:1 backing by LBMA-certified gold reserves and Hong Kong physical redemption for qualified holders. Terms of Sale & Service still define Metal Tokens as an undivided interest in vaulted LBMA-standard metal held with qualified custodians in Hong Kong, with supply intended to match audited custody balances (subject to operational tolerances) and optional Chainlink PoR/periodic reports that 'do not replace legal audits.' GlobeNewswire 2025-10-29 launch release still states each PGOLD represents one troy ounce of LBMA-certified physical gold stored in institutional vaults. Official pleasinggold.com returns HTTP 200 but is a client-rendered SPA with no crawlable reserve text. No PGOLD-specific proof-of-reserve, bar list, named custodian, gold-quantity reconciliation, or dated independent reserve report is published (docs PoR/monthly-report pages exist only under USDpm; the PGOLD audit page is a smart-contract security file attachment only).

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The physical-gold reserve category is identified by issuer product and legal materials, but current reserve quantities, independent assurance, custody provider identity, segregation, rehypothecation, insurance, and redemption liquidity are not independently evidenced.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Re-opened 2026-07-28: Terms still place vaulted metal with 'qualified custodians in Hong Kong' and say detailed custodian relationships 'are disclosed in the Transparency page,' but no public Transparency page or named vault/custodian list was found. How PGOLD works and the launch release restate institutional vault storage and Hong Kong redemption without naming providers. Segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation, insurance coverage, and current reserve evidence remain undisclosed.
